test_title: PYST 65: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing out to the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). D is sitting to the immediate left of A and third to the right of H. B is sitting third to the right of F. F is the immediate neighbour of C and G. C is sitting third to the right of A.

Who is sitting fourth to the right of A?
solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing out to the centre.

D is sitting to the immediate left of A and third to the right of H.

C is sitting third to the right of A.

B is sitting third to the right of F.

F is the immediate neighbour of C and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/713ec8f07c4f1248b2b409a20e97a4928be323fcf2007fb33ce499b22b44fd26.png] 

Thus, H is sitting fourth to the right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
